status: Frozen audit design before any model comparison;not an executable profile
frequency: calendar month,period YYYY-MM;no invented timezone offset for monthly labels
window: Expanding from2000-01;at each origin only periods<=origin may be fitted/used. Refit after earlier outcomes resolve is allowed under frozen selection policy;no tuning on test outcomes.
selection: Freeze candidate set,initialization,hyperparameters,tie order and metrics before validation. Select on validation macro MAE;retrain through2020-12 for first test origin. Later refits keep model family/hyperparameters fixed. Report every planned candidate/failure,not only winner.
transforms: Identity on ppm by default. Any optional scaler/transform/imputer/decomposition fitted separately on each training prefix and serialized. Never center a rolling feature using future rows,globally normalize or decompose the complete dataset.
missing: Require a complete regular monthly grid;duplicates,out-of-order and irregular labels reject. Missing target outcomes remain unscored with denominators;do not use future interpolation/backfill. First bounded models reject missing training values,with later causal imputation separately named.
features: If tree/neural routes added:shift before rolling;label availability,not row index alone,governs training. Direct h-step labels must be fully observed by fold origin;purge unobserved label windows. Recursive h>1 inputs use earlier predictions,not actual future targets.
covariates: None in initial benchmark. Calendar month is known future. Other future covariates require as-of availability references;observed future weather/prices are forbidden. Past-only covariates cannot be passed as known future.
multi_series: Initial dataset has one series. Additional series require group-aware temporal splits;linked/revised targets and cross-series batches must have common as-of cutoff. Disable Chronos cross_learning until independently evaluated;pin batch grouping when enabled.
availability: NOAA file is a revised2026snapshot,not archived publication vintages. Monthly means are corrected by the provider toward midmonth using seasonal-cycle information. This supports retrospective fixed-series held-out evaluation,not a certified leakage-free historical real-time replay. Missing historical release times/revisions are unresolved;prospective skill claims require as-of vintages or new prospective observations.
pretraining: Chronos card lists chronos_datasets/GiftEvalPretrain;exact overlap with NOAA or other benchmarks not excluded. No claim that a frozen test period is unseen by model pretraining.
dependence: 25 origins x12h=300 cells per partition/model but only36distinct target months. Report all denominators and horizon-wise results;overlapping forecast errors are dependent,no independent-trial or significance claim.
candidate_convention: Proposed finite CPU set for the subsequent implementation. SES starts level at first training observation,then consumes subsequent observations with fixed alpha;no SSE/MLE optimization or fitted ETS distribution claimed. Lowest validation MAE wins;exact ties use the listed order. Core fixtures/conventions still must be committed before production.
optional_distributional_request: If a later verified Chronos adapter is included,request native0.05,0.1,0.5,0.9,0.95quantiles,horizon12,record point functional=median. No interval generation or adapter in this audit.
